description: This file is a PHP source file defining performance monitoring functions and classes for the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes functions for memory usage, CPU load, SQL logging, and performance analysis, as well as a class 'adodb_perf' that provides a comprehensive UI and methods for database performance diagnostics and logging.

classes.name: adodb_perf
classes.description: A class providing performance monitoring and tuning features, including SQL logging, performance analysis, and UI for performance diagnostics.

methods.name: adodb_getmem
methods.description: Returns the current process's memory usage in KB, or 0 if not available.

methods.name: adodb_round
methods.description: Formats a number with specified precision, using '.' as decimal separator.

methods.name: adodb_microtime
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp with microsecond precision as a float.

methods.name: adodb_log_sql
methods.description: Logs and times the execution of an SQL query through the database connection.
